Insurance surveyors in Dubai

From our Bur Dubai headquarters, COGS Global mobilizes licensed surveyors across the UAE for damage surveys, liability investigations, and specialist engineering assessments. We serve insurer panels and single-instruction appointments.

Office: Al Khaleej Center, 6th Floor, Al Mankhool Road, Bur Dubai — near Sharaf DG Metro.

Survey types

  • Initial loss and damage surveys
  • Joint surveys with insured representatives
  • Salvage and mitigation oversight
  • Third-party and subrogation support

Frequently asked questions

Are you licensed insurance surveyors in Dubai?

COGS Global Surveyors & Loss Adjusters L.L.C. is registered and licensed for insurance survey and loss adjustment activities in the UAE under the Central Bank of the UAE framework.

How quickly can a surveyor attend in Dubai?

Attendance timing depends on claim severity and access. We prioritize life-safety and major commercial losses; confirm SLA expectations during panel onboarding.

Do you cover other emirates?

Yes. We serve the wider UAE and GCC through resident engineers and mobilization from Dubai and regional offices.
